name: Krishna Taratibea Alayawickrom Aibak
original_name: クリシュナ＝タラティベア＝ アラヤウィクロム＝アイバック
source:
A young man who looks like Soi.
He wears a talking hat called "Crow" on his head.
The reason he came to Silver Star Academy is a huge secret.
